tasks.status_evidence: Completed 2026-08-23 by VERIFICATION + the missing oracle, not by a new module. REQ-1616 asks for two things and both exist: the governed playbook/job-template ACTUATOR is the awx-job effect lane (AWX is Ansible with an API; a fixed template id + typed extra_vars is a strictly narrower channel than raw SSH), inert at Shadow twice over; the read-only SENSOR capability is knowledge/awxplaybooks (read-only token, GET-only) plus hostdiag's fixed-argv host reads. What had no oracle was the SPLIT — now pinned in modules/actuation/awxjob/req1616_sensor_actuator_test.go with a vacuity floor (the armed actuator must NOT read read-only, or the Shadow assertion proves nothing). The task's predicted modules/actuation/ansible/ansible.go is deliberately NOT built: an un-controlled Ansible actuator is UNBUILDABLE under distroless + INV-02 (no binary, no shell, no subprocess), and an AWX ad-hoc "gather facts" sensor was refused on review — an ad-hoc command RUNS a module on the target, so it is a remote execution channel bought for facts hostdiag already gathers without one. The reasoning is in the test file header so the next reader does not re-derive it.
